content.text: invalid-options: timeseries does not accept these options: options.legend.position is not an option; options.legend.showLegend is set two times; options.lineWidth must be integer 0..20; options.tooltip must be object; fieldConfig.defaults.min must be number; fieldConfig.overrides[0].custom.lineColor is not an option; fieldConfig.overrides[1] must be {"matcher":{"id":"byName"|"byRegexp"|"byFrameRefID","options":"<name, regular expression or refId>"},"properties":[{"id":"<path>","value":<value>}]}; fieldConfig.mappings is not an option. get_chart_options lists the options of timeseries.
